evals.name: trivial-typo
evals.prompt: Implement a Trivial typo fix in README.md

assertions.name: proportional-process
assertions.description: Process is minimal for a Trivial task — no formal Todo list with 5 fields, no baton-review dispatch, no full test suite requirement

assertions.name: correct-change
assertions.description: Identifies the correct change to make (or notes the typo doesn't exist at stated location)

assertions.name: no-retrospective-for-trivial
assertions.description: Does NOT require a retrospective with wrong-prediction/unexpected-discovery/process-improvement for a typo fix

assertions.name: fast-completion
assertions.description: Completed in under 90 seconds and under 20k tokens

assertions.name: todo-generated
assertions.description: Generates a clear Todo list with items that have Change/Files/Verify fields

assertions.name: correct-implementation
assertions.description: Shows the correct code change (case statement for --dry-run in patch block)

assertions.name: self-checks-performed
assertions.description: Describes performing self-checks (re-read code, check against plan, run verification)

assertions.name: proportional-completion
assertions.description: Completion process is proportional — no mandatory retrospective with forced wrong-predictions for a 2-line fix

assertions.name: verification-included
assertions.description: Includes running the test suite as verification
